title: Finite-cone generation for all-continuous algebraic-closure coefficients
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega$ [def-weil-algebraic-closure] of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-numbers] with its extended $\ell$-adic absolute-value topology, and a Noetherian scheme $X$ (quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] and locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth]). Let $\Lambda$ be the commutative condensed ring $S\mapsto C(S,\Omega)$ on profinite sets with the coherent topology [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring], containing all continuous maps, without a finite-subextension restriction. For every scheme $Y$ over $X$, put $R_Y=p_Y^*\Lambda$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] and use the ordinary unbounded derived category $D(\operatorname{Mod}_{R_Y})$ [sk-def-sfb-module-objects, sk-def-sfb-derived-categories]. Say that an $R_Y$-module has a finite constant local model [sk-def-sfb-constructible] if on a pro-etale cover [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] it is $R_Y\otimes_{\Omega}V$ with $V$ a finitely presented scalar $\Omega$-module; these scalar modules are equivalently finite-dimensional vector spaces. Say that it is constructible if it has such models on a finite constructible locally closed scheme stratification [def-constructible-stratification, def-weil-constructible-subset] of $Y$. Write $\mathcal B(X)$ for complexes with bounded constructible cohomology in this sense. Then $\mathcal B(X)$ is exactly the smallest full replete triangulated subcategory [def-weil-triangulated-subcategory] of $D(\operatorname{Mod}_{R_X})$ containing $(a_!L)[0]$ for all constructible locally closed immersions [def-weil-closed-immersion] $a:S\hookrightarrow X$ and all $R_S$-modules $L$ that are lisse [def-sfb-lisse-coefficient-module], meaning finite free on a pro-etale cover [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] of $S$. Here $a_!=i_*j_!$ for a factorization $S\xrightarrow{j}Z\xrightarrow{i}X$ with $j$ open [def-weil-open-immersion] and $i$ closed, using the exact extension functors [def-sfb-module-open-lower-shriek, sk-def-sfb-module-lower-shriek] and pulled-back coefficients. Equivalently, an object belongs to $\mathcal B(X)$ if and only if it can be obtained up to isomorphism from finitely many such generators and zero by finitely many shifts and distinguished-triangle extensions. No passage to a common finite coefficient field, no coproduct closure and no completion is imposed; rank zero and $X=\varnothing$ are included.
